title: Stage Modifiers
description: Object keyed by stage name (APPROACH, HIGH_CAMP, SUMMIT_DAY). Values are applied additively to EP and BT calculations by the turn-resolution pipeline.

fatigueMultiplier.description: Stage-level multiplier applied to fatigue costs (stacks with action modifier).

exposureMultiplier.description: Stage-level multiplier applied to exposure costs.

weatherSeverityBias.description: Additive offset to weatherSeverityBias in EP calculation.

confidencePenalty.description: Subtracted from perceived confidence at this stage.
